# `gcp.redis.cluster`

A Google Cloud Redis Cluster instance.

[redis](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | redis |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `redis.googleapis.com/Cluster` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: encoder (encoders/redis_cluster.go.tmpl) re-expands automatedBackupConfig when it is absent, and its expander returns nil for an absent block, so nothing is sent. Configured, the expander derives automatedBackupMode ENABLED. THE BOUNDED GAP: write automatedBackupMode yourself.
decoder (decoders/redis_cluster.go.tmpl) GETs the cluster's certificateAuthority and copies managedServerCa into Terraform's state. That field is not in the v1 Cluster schema; read the CA through getCertificateAuthority.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 1200s |
